title: Instagram Limits Reach of Undisclosed AI Profiles
dek: The platform is responding to rising frustration over AI influencers by limiting distribution for AI-run profiles that do not disclose their nature.
socialCaption: Instagram is limiting the reach of AI profiles that do not disclose their nature. For brands and builders, AI transparency may now affect distribution as well as trust.
